description: This file defines a set of API endpoints using FastAPI for managing configurations, feature toggles, and runtime settings in a student management system. It includes CRUD operations, filtering, pagination, and access control through dependencies, as well as endpoints for checking feature enablement and bulk updates.

classes.name: ConfigService
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling business logic related to configurations and feature toggles, interacting with the database models and schemas.
